data.description: Japan's Nikkei share average rebounded on Thursday after a three-day losing streak.  AI-related shares tracked gains in the U.S. technology sector, boosting the index.  Higher oil prices, however, kept investor optimism in check following renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities.  The Nikkei 225 index climbed 1.4% to close at 67,743.85 points.  Market breadth was negative as gains were skewed by heavily weighted stocks.
